text:
Maya: Heads up — I need to step out Tue 14:00–18:30 PT for a dentist emergency. Can someone cover the 14:00–18:00 window? I can do a quick handoff now.

Sam: I can take 14:00–16:00 PT if that helps. Will be online and able to escalate.

Linh: I can pick up 16:00–18:30 PT if Sam covers the first half. happy to shadow for the handoff.

Maya: Awesome, @Sam + @Linh that works. Quick notes: there’s a deploy scheduled at 15:20 (small infra tweak) — please watch the canary route (route: /generate-canary). If latency spikes, rollback to v1.3.2.

Maya: Runbook snippet: ```
# check canary health
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.example.com/health/canary | jq .status
# tail recent error logs
stern inference-runtime -n redwood --since 10m | grep ERROR
```

Jorge: Thanks for the snippet. Where’s the short checklist for cache warmup? Last time we saw cold-start + kv-cache misses around 15:00.

Maya: Good call. Short warmup: call the canary route with a 512-token prompt + warm 4 concurrent sessions for ~90s. Example: ```for i in {1..4}; do curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example.com/generate-canary -d '{"prompt":"warmup"}' & done; wait``` That should populate the KV cache for frequent prefixes.

Sam: I’ll run the warmup at 14:45 and leave monitoring on. If I see token error spikes or 5xx > 2% in 5m, I’ll flip the canary to stable and ping infra.

Linh: Also, FYI: There’s a short background job (batch-embeddings) that runs 15:05–15:25 and sometimes increases GPU memory pressure. I’ll keep an eye on mem metrics 15:00–15:30.

Maya: Perfect — added to the handoff: watch canary latency, run warmup at 14:45, monitor GPU memory 15:00–15:30, and be prepared to rollback deploy at 15:20 if errors trend up. Escalation path: ping #eng-sre + page oncall if rollback needed.

Sam: Got it. I’ll set a short dashboard alert: latency p95 > 600ms or errors > 2% for 5m. Posting screenshot in thread if it trips.

oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation: Sam (14:00–16:00), Linh (16:00–18:30).

Jorge: One small ask — if you flip the canary, please include the reason in the deploy ticket and link the error trace. Helps with post-mortem.

Maya: Will do. I’m leaving my laptop open until 14:10 to hand off SSH keys and the short checklist. Thanks so much, team. :pray:

Sam: No problem — covering. I’ll DM you if I need the runbook link.

Linh: I’ll be available from 16:00. Enjoy the dentist (hope it’s quick). :tooth:
